rationale: The assistant correctly identified E:25 as a blocked drain pump, gave safe steps (unplug, gloves, teaspoon, pump cover and impeller check), and conditionally mentioned pump replacement only if the problem persisted. After the customer cleared the glass sliver and the machine drained, it confirmed the fix and added sensible follow-up checks. Slight overconfidence in 'almost certainly' and some generic details (e.g. the Start-hold reset), but nothing unsafe or invented.
